name: How long does it take to complete a wheelchair accessible doorway project?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to complete a wheelchair accessible doorway project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a wheelchair accessible doorway project can vary based on its complexity. A simple widening of a non-load-bearing wall might take a few days. Projects involving structural changes, permit acquisition, and extensive finishing work could take several weeks. We provide a detailed timeline after assessing the scope of your specific project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies; simple widening can take days, while complex structural changes and permits may extend to several weeks.
